# human/filter

A built-in filter adapter for records of any type: it needs the step's `uses:` fields and declares no fields of its own. It publishes no per-record estimate, so plan prints `?`, and it demands no credential.

## Manifest

| Key | Value |
|---|---|
| id | `human/filter` |
| version | 1 |
| role | filter |
| entity type | any type |
| credentials | none |
| cost estimate per record | not published |

## Needs

The fields the step's `uses:` line names, and nothing else.

## Provides

A verdict per record. Fields declared in the step's `provides:` land beside it.

## Config keys

The keys `with:` accepts. Plan rejects any other key.

| Key | Type | Required | What it sets |
|---|---|---|---|
| `of` | string |  | The referent (ADR-048): the field whose value this step is about. Injected by the runner from the step-level of: key — never authored inside with:. |
| `prompt` | one of tty, never |  | tty (default): at a terminal, `gtme run` walks the records and asks; never: every record waits in the ledger for `gtme answer` (ADR-049). The mode, never text — the text is template: (ADR-057) |
| `provides` | object |  | The step's derived provides schema (ADR-033) — the menu the participant answers. Injected by the runner from the step-level provides: key — never authored inside with:. |
| `render` | object |  | What the participant is shown per record (ADR-049): the listed fields, or the step's template: (ADR-057) |
| `render.fields` | array of string |  | The fields shown to the participant (default: the uses: fields, or the of: value alone); validated as uses: (SPEC §7) |
| `template` | string |  | What the participant is shown per record (ADR-057): a template over record.* (the uses:/of: fields) and config.*, in place of the field listing. The runner loads {file:} before validation. |

## Example

A minimal step:

```yaml
  - id: filter
    use: human/filter
```
